_readme: Log housekeeping - auto-purge of the batch-log directories. Copy this file to 'housekeeping.json'
(same folder) and edit per server; housekeeping.json is git-ignored. Every value is OPTIONAL -
anything omitted falls back to the built-in default shown below.
enabled        : turn the scheduled purge on/off (default true).
log_dirs       : LIST of directories to housekeep. Each folder is cleaned INDEPENDENTLY, so the
keep_min floor applies PER folder (a quiet folder never gets emptied). Add as many
as you like. A relative path resolves against the backend dir (portable); an
absolute path is used as-is. Only files DIRECTLY in each folder are touched -
sub-folders are NOT descended into, so list each sub-folder you want cleaned.
(A single 'log_dir': '...' string is also accepted for one folder.)
max_age_days   : delete files older than this many days (default 30).
keep_min       : ALWAYS keep at least this many newest files in EACH folder, regardless of age, so
a quiet period (no new logs for a long time) never empties a folder (default 2).
interval_hours : how often the background task runs (default 24).
The task runs once at backend startup, then every interval_hours. Change a value here and RESTART
the backend for it to take effect. (Any key can still be overridden per-server by the matching
